title: GrowthBook latest posts (v2)
description: A railed section whose background fades from the page colour to a pale mint: a heading, one large featured post on the left (wide gradient thumbnail, tiny mono category, 24px title, muted line) and three compact posts on the right (thumbnail beside category and title). notes: every thumbnail is a media slot (a gradient placeholder when empty)
